hero_summary: Software Engineer and Technical Manager with 5+ years of experience in .NET development and process automation (RPA). I've worked across the whole lifecycle: from implementation and process analysis to architecture design and technical team coordination.
about_desc_1: I hold a degree in Computer Engineering – Software Engineering from the University of Seville and work as Technical Manager | .NET Automation at Servinform.
about_desc_2: I was born in Encinasola, a small town in the Sierra de Huelva, and live in Seville. I started out in programming and ended up in automation: I like building reliable systems that save people time, and leading the teams that deliver them well.
work5_bullets:
• Management of multiple development projects, overseeing delivery timelines and ensuring the technical quality of solutions.
  • Technical supervision and guidance for development teams, supporting design and architecture decisions with high engineering standards.
  • Coordination and allocation of developers and analysts across client projects based on skills, priorities and project needs.
  • Main technical point of contact between internal teams and clients.
work4_bullets:
• Detailed process analysis and authoring of Process and Solution Design Documents (PDD/SDD).
  • Close work with business users to translate their needs into technical requirements.
  • Prioritization of key automation initiatives, with significant operational cost savings.
  • Technical support and troubleshooting for bots in production.
  • Contribution to the design and development of internal applications and to the architecture of the company's core product.
work3_bullets:
• Development of robust, scalable RPA bots with UiPath Studio, following best practices and coding standards.
  • Integration of RPA solutions with web, desktop and API-based applications.
  • Unit, system integration and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Creation and maintenance of technical documentation for RPA processes and automations.
work2_bullets:
• Built new features for key software products, taking on more responsibility across a larger number of projects after the internship.
  • Debugged and resolved software issues, improving application stability.
work1_bullets: • Internship in the Organization and Systems department: training in process robotization tools and Azure cloud services, plus testing and development of technical solutions.
